disposition_reason: Figure 5d has a genuine ordered mean-position-error endpoint, but the paper and pinned author notebooks disagree on preprocessing/support and checkpoint training provenance is missing. A four-rat clean/half-neuron evaluation, median error or1,999 query rows cannot replace the original 2,000-observation within-rat comparison.

source_paper.title: MARBLE: interpretable representations of neural population dynamics using geometric deep learning

evidence.locator: Figure 5c-d; Methods: Linear maze experiments in rats
evidence.supports: Original within-animal mean absolute position error,32-dimensional representation,36 cosine neighbors and2,000 observations; paper preprocessing description.

evidence.locator: split_data, preprocessing, checkpoint-loading and main comparison cells
evidence.supports: Achilles chronological 80/20 split, training PCA 20, checkpoint routes and mean-error plot; this recipe is not proven equivalent to publication.

evidence.locator: CEBRA training loop and MARBLE loop
evidence.supports: Full-recording model fitting, behavior-label access and PCA 10 MARBLE training; historical checkpoint lineage remains unresolved.
Final-row omission, per-row and median error outputs, and time-unit interpretation requiring reconciliation.

evidence.locator: four-rat clean/half populations, dimensions3/32 and complete fit/query roles
evidence.supports: The existing source comparator is a prospective extension; its authored reference is not a published author baseline.

target.description: Decode rat position within rat1 in Figure 5d; cross-animal consistency is a distinct secondary result.

dataset.description: Original rat hippocampal linear-maze recording is identified; the registered rat_data.pkl route and original Figure 5d support/checkpoint joins remain unadmitted.

cohort.description: Figure 5d is a within-rat1 comparison; the author decoding notebook selects Achilles. This does not justify a pooled four-rat replacement.

split.description: Pinned decoder uses chronological 80/20; publication reports2,000 observations while helper omission yields1999. Historical fit/query membership is unverified.

inputs.description: Neural firing-rate inputs are identified, but exact historical supervision and query-neural access differ by method; CEBRA-behavior full-label fitting is present in the training notebook.

preprocessing.description: Paper PCA 5 on the animal data, decoder train-only PCA 20 and MARBLE training PCA 10 are not silently reconciled; smoothing time units and final-row handling also remain open.

metric.description: Mean absolute position error: sum(abs(predicted_position-true_position))/n on the original Figure 5d support, using32-dimensional embeddings and36-neighbor cosine decoding.

aggregation.description: Mean within the original rat/query support, with source standard deviation; median error and pooled multi-animal scores are different endpoints.

comparison.primary_metric: Figure 5d within-rat mean absolute position error

published_baseline.description: No authenticated numeric MARBLE Figure 5d baseline has been recovered; the plotted result is not replaced by a guessed/digitized value.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Official decoding notebook names MARBLE 7659512, CEBRA-time 7609517 and CEBRA-behavior 7609520 checkpoints, but bytes, training provenance and numeric results are not admitted.

minimum_effect.rationale: Define a position-error reduction in the verified physical units after resolving original preprocessing and baseline variability; no generic percent or centimeter margin is invented.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare a dependence-aware paired comparison on original support; derive defensible track-traversal/time-block units after protocol recovery. Source Wilcoxon reporting is not proof of2000independent biological observations.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Original rat recording with dependent time samples; independent traversal/block definition unresolved
uncertainty.rationale: Do not turn correlated time bins into independent animals or add animals while claiming the same Figure 5d endpoint.

paper_win_requires: Recover exact original Figure 5d query support, preprocessing, label access and authenticated checkpoint/recipe lineage.
Use mean error on all original2,000 observations with the source decoder and input regime; do not substitute helper median or1,999 support.
Qualify the numeric source result and author rerun separately, then freeze meaningful effect, dependence-aware uncertainty and fixed budgets before candidate iteration.
Preserve the four-rat clean/half-neuron comparator as a labelled extension; a win there is not a source-paper win.

current_sota.description: CEBRA is a historical paper comparator. No matched present-day SOTA result is verified; later differing-rat/split/decoder/median evaluations cannot establish it.

episode.improvement_loop: Source-baseline admission first. Later iterate only with declared development feedback after original protocol/support is recovered; do not repurpose the four-rat extension as source evaluation.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze method, preprocessing, supervision, decoder, dimensionality and all selection decisions before one admitted final original-support evaluation.
episode.final_evaluation: Compare against both authenticated published mean error and qualified author rerun under the same original protocol. Public exposure must be recorded; isolation cannot make published targets unseen.
episode.baseline_policy: Official checkpoint metadata is a recovery route, not a baseline score. Locally authored train-only comparators are separately labelled and do not repair publication-lineage discrepancies.

blocking_issues: Numeric source baseline and checkpoint bytes/training provenance not admitted.
Paper/PCA 5, decoder/PCA 20 and training/PCA 10 correspondence unresolved.
Published 2,000 versus  helper1,999 query support, physical time units and original supervision unresolved.
Meaningful effect, independent uncertainty units, fixed access/resource budgets and qualified same-task evaluator missing.

legacy.notes: Keep fit-closed-comparator, complete48 fit/96 reference coverage and original graders unchanged as calibration/extension evidence. Reuse source-admission findings; do not treat newly authored four-rat support as Figure 5d equivalence.
